data.title: Income tax assessment 2025: €634 to pay
data.summary: Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 dated 26 March 2026. Tax is set at €11,405.00, and after €10,771.00 of withheld wage tax, an additional payment of €634.00 is due by 30 April 2026.
data.explanation: This is your final income tax decision for 2025. Your employer withheld less wage tax than the tax calculated, so you owe €634.00. Pay it to the Finanzamt account shown, using the payment reference, by 30 April 2026. If you disagree with the assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically via ELSTER, or in person for the record; the app shows the deadline. Note that the letter is dated 26 March 2026 but says it was posted on 30 March 2026. If unsure whether to object, a tax adviser or income tax help association can advise.
